summary.text: Mark C. Downey is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 69th District, which covers part of Gloucester County, part of James City County, part of York County and part of the city of Newport News, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Downey sits on the House committees on Counties, Cities and Towns and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Mark C. Downey was born in Washington, DC, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Downey's education as Bruton High School (1984); University of Virginia (B.S., Chemical Engineering, 1988); Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine (Doctor of Medicine, 1996); and the Strong Memorial Hospital Internal Medicine/Pediatric Residency Program (2000).
The profile gives Downey's occupation as pediatrician.

Downey's listed memberships and affiliations include American Academy of Pediatrics; Children’s Hospital of the Kings Daughters; Pediatric Associates of Williamsburg; Macon & Joan Brock Virginia Health Sciences at Old Dominion University; Sentara Williamsburg Regional Medical Center; Riverside Doctors Hospital Williamsburg.
